  - text: CLASS 11 · RELATIONS AND FUNCTIONS
  - heading "Onto Functions" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Onto (surjective) functions: every element of the codomain has at least one preimage in the domain."
  - navigation: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT surjectivity
  - button "← School lessons"
  - main:
    - complementary:
      - heading "SURJECTIVITY CHALLENGE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Connect each domain element to exactly one element in the codomain using arrows.
      - article:
        - heading "Example:" [level=3]
        - strong: f(x) = x − 1
        - paragraph: "Let A = {−1,0,1,2} and B = {−2,−1,0,1}."
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - row "x -1 0 1 2":
              - columnheader "x"
              - columnheader "-1"
              - columnheader "0"
              - columnheader "1"
              - columnheader "2"
          - rowgroup:
            - row "f(x) -2 -1 0 1":
              - rowheader "f(x)"
              - cell "-2"
              - cell "-1"
              - cell "0"
              - cell "1"
        - img
        - text: "Range(f) = {−2,−1,0,1} = B So, f is onto."
      - article:
        - heading "ⓘ Key Points" [level=3]
        - paragraph: ✓ Onto means every element of the codomain is hit by at least one arrow.
        - paragraph: ✓ Multiple domain elements may map to the same codomain element.
    - article:
      - heading "Domain (A)" [level=2]
      - button "-1"
      - button "0"
      - button "1"
      - button "2"
    - img "Onto function arrows"
    - article:
      - heading "Codomain (B)" [level=2]
      - button "-2"
      - button "-1"
      - button "0"
      - button "1"
    - article:
      - heading "Codomain coverage" [level=2]
      - text: "-2"
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Preimages:"
        - strong: "1"
        - text: "from: {-1}"
      - text: ✓ -1
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Preimages:"
        - strong: "1"
        - text: "from: {0}"
      - text: ✓ 0
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Preimages:"
        - strong: "1"
        - text: "from: {1}"
      - text: ✓ 1
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Preimages:"
        - strong: "1"
        - text: "from: {2}"
      - text: ✓ Coverage meter
      - progressbar
      - strong: 100%
      - paragraph: All codomain elements are covered. This mapping is ONTO (surjective).
    - heading "Check surjectivity" [level=3]
    - button "Test surjective":
      - img
      - text: Test surjective
    - paragraph: "Result: Not checked Range(f) = Codomain"
    - heading "Exact statement" [level=3]
    - strong: Range(f) = Codomain
    - paragraph: Every element of the codomain has at least one preimage.
    - button "Reset arrows Start a new mapping":
      - img
      - text: Reset arrows Start a new mapping
